description: Verified push protocol corpus: success, rejection, timeout, response-loss, ref-race against disposable local bare repositories

push_failures.description: Non-fast-forward push rejected by remote; run remains non-delivered and PR-unreachable
assertions: no remote_observation with observed_remote_oid is recorded
delivery intent has no successful ls-remote observation

push_failures.description: Push command exceeds timeout deadline; run remains non-delivered
Push succeeds but process crashes before ls-remote observation; resume completes idempotently
assertions: push observation is persisted before crash
resume re-observes via ls-remote without re-pushing
ls-remote OID equals delivery OID after resume

push_failures.description: Remote ref moved after push; ls-remote shows a different OID than delivery OID
assertions: ls-remote observed OID differs from delivery OID

push_success.description: Push to local bare repo succeeds and ls-remote independently confirms the exact delivery OID
assertions: ls-remote observed OID equals delivery OID
delivery intent is persisted with exact OID/remote/branch
remote observation sequence is push=1, ls-remote=2
